recommendation: Keep the source fix. If broader CanonicalResource context-reference propagation is pursued, handle it separately under FHIR-53850 or a later applied/published decision rather than expanding this FHIR-17245 reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-17245 was Published/Persuasive and asked that the useContext search parameters added to MetadataResource be inherited consistently by resources using MetadataResource as a template.
initial_application: The original useContext search-parameter family came from FHIR-13565 and FHIR-13566 in imported SVN/Git commit bc0e408c80a3d8ff7d558e023496ecffd4d76e7b. No explicit FHIR-17245 source commit was found; Jira records that the parameters were being applied consistently in October 2018. Current per-resource search bundles already had the parameters on most active MetadataResource descendants, but ObservationDefinition and SpecimenDefinition still lacked them.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists ObservationDefinition and SpecimenDefinition in the active [resources] section and also gives them abbreviations and approval entries. MedicationKnowledge and ConditionDefinition have MetadataResource source files but are not in the active [resources] list, so they were not edited. Later context-reference work from FHIR-37570 is already represented on the combined branch, while broader FHIR-53850 propagation work is Resolved - change required and outside this default applied/published seed scope.
reconciliation: Added context, context-quantity, context-type, context-type-quantity, and context-type-value SearchParameter entries over useContext to source/observationdefinition/bundle-ObservationDefinition-search-params.xml and source/specimendefinition/bundle-SpecimenDefinition-search-params.xml, matching the established inherited MetadataResource pattern used by other active resources.
source_changes: source/observationdefinition/bundle-ObservationDefinition-search-params.xml: added the five inherited useContext search parameters for ObservationDefinition.
source/specimendefinition/bundle-SpecimenDefinition-search-params.xml: added the five inherited useContext search parameters for SpecimenDefinition.
